# MapLibre GL JS 6.6.0

This directory contains the browser distribution of MapLibre GL JS 6.6.0.

- Upstream: https://github.com/maplibre/maplibre-gl-js
- License: BSD 3-Clause (`LICENSE.txt`)
- Files are copied verbatim from the published `maplibre-gl@6.6.0` package.

PandoLab loads these files locally so the editor does not depend on a CDN at runtime.
